lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular grid distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes in a rectangular grid configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Continuous linear features running parallel to the longitudinal axis on the dorsal-lateral flank, marked by a high-contrast gradient with lighter pixel values on the dorsal edge and darker shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, high-luminance spots are distributed sparsely across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark silhouettes (commensal remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and the lower pectoral fin.
